articles.title: Gatto - Official Trailer - IGN
articles.summary: Check out the trailer for Disney and Pixar's Gatto, an upcoming animated film featuring the voice talents of Mark Ruffalo, Laurence Fishburne, Enrico Casarosa (who also serves as director), Bianca Babaşa as Maja, Sherry Cola as Regina, John Turturro as Capitano Briganti, Rumen Sali Shopov as Papu Janko, Rhys Darby as Focaccia, Isabella Rossellini as Contessa, Natasia Demetriou as Charon, Jamie Demetriou as Plague Doctor, Jason Schwartzman as Vivaldi, Saverio Raimondo as Ugo, Jason Mantzoukas as Rico, Matt Jones as Enzo, Austin Madison as Fishmonger, Beatrice Manfredi as Martinelli, Jesse Andrews as Bartolomeo, Tracey Ullman as Luisa, and Marco Calvani as Maestro Foscari.In Gatto, after years of maneuvering the canal-ridden, superstitious city of Venice, Italy, Nero (voiced by Mark Ruffalo) begins to question whether he’s lived the right lives. Indebted to Rocco (voiced by Laurence Fishburne), the local feline mob boss, Nero finds himself in a quandary and is forced to forge a truly unexpected friendship with Maja, a local street musician. With his last life on the line and some help from Maja, Nero may finally discover his true purpose – unless Venice gets the better of him first. Gatto is directed by Enrico Casarosa and produced by Andrea Warren, the filmmaking team behind the Oscar-nominated feature Luca.Gatto opens in theaters on March 5, 2027.
